description: Read a file attached to a ticket, from get_ticket's attachments: a photo comes back as an image, a PDF or a text, CSV, Markdown or JSON file as text. A long file is cut at 150,000 characters and says so; an archive or other kind is refused by name, with the ticket's link so the person can open it in the app.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: get_attachment
title: Read an attachment
